overview.title: Leading Automotive Gas System Integration in Guwahati
overview.lead: Conveniently situated on NH-37, Paschim Boragaon, Garchuk, Maa Kamakhya Auto Gas operates at the forefront of clean automotive propulsion in Assam.
overview.p1: As an authorized conversion center, we do not treat alternative fuel conversion as a generic mechanical swap. Every vehicle model possesses unique manifold geometries, ignition profiles, and intake parameters. Our workshop integrates calibrated sequential gas injection systems with precision ECU remapping, ensuring optimal engine response, zero check-engine warnings, and substantial 60-70% monthly fuel savings.
overview.p2: From retail and wholesale fitment of certified Italian and Indian conversion kits to multi-point cylinder safety inspections, computer diagnostics, and DTO registration endorsement support, we handle every vehicle with engineering care.

howItWorks.title: Structured 4-Stage Conversion Process
howItWorks.description: Every vehicle undergoes a disciplined, step-by-step engineering cycle from first inspection to legal handover.

steps.title: Pre-Fitment Assessment
steps.description: Diagnostic scan of ignition health, compression ratios, and electrical harness compatibility with the chosen kit.

steps.title: Precision Hardware Fitment
steps.description: Installation of high-pressure seamless cylinders, calibrated reducers, multi-point rail injectors, and rigid gas piping.

steps.title: Digital ECU Calibration
steps.description: Software-driven fuel mapping and road-load testing to calibrate air-fuel ratios seamlessly across RPM bands.

steps.title: Safety Audit & Handover
steps.description: Electronic sniff-testing for micro-leaks, compliance certificate issue, and guidance through final DTO RC endorsement.
